rennetCurd.text: Rennet makes the casein clot into a gel. Cutting the gel into grains lets the whey run out, and this whey is the sweet whey; cheese curd and sweet whey come from the one draining. The finer the cut, the drier the finished cheese.

sweetWhey.text: Rennet sets the casein but leaves the whey proteins in solution, so the liquid that drains off keeps nearly all the milk's lactose and whey protein and is only mildly acidic. Little acid has formed, so the whey proteins and the caseinomacropeptide stay intact, which is why this whey is the starting point for most whey products.
